## Flag reference

### `/mat-doctor`

- `--full` (optional) — Run the full doctor pass.
- `--quality-commands` (optional) — Advisory fake-green quality-command scan.
- `--research-skills` (optional) — Advisory discovery/research skill honesty scan.
- `--rules-precedence` (optional) — Advisory rules/plugin/sidecar collision and shadowing hints.
- `--adoption` (optional) — Adoption provenance summary (no secrets).
- `--commands` (optional) — Print four primary entry paths from the command registry.
- `--mao` (optional) — MAO generated-artifact status vocabulary (advisory).
- `--run-manifest` (optional) — Advisory N4 run manifest list and stale hash check.

### `/mat-plan`

- `--depth` (optional) — Thin router to lite/standard/onboarding/team/long-run (explicit aliases only).
